suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide a login page with username, password, and domain selection fields.
The system shall authenticate users and redirect them to their respective domain (coordinator, customer, or supplier).
The system shall display an error page if the provided username or password is incorrect.
The system shall allow the coordinator to manage customers, suppliers, requests, and items.
The system shall allow the coordinator to add, view, edit, and delete customer records.
The system shall allow the coordinator to add, view, edit, and delete item records.
The system shall allow the coordinator to add, view, edit, and delete supplier records.
The system shall allow the coordinator to add, view, edit, and delete requests.
The system shall allow the customer to add, view, edit, and delete their requests.
The system shall allow the customer to edit their profile.
The system shall allow the supplier to view pending requests.
The system shall allow the supplier to submit feedback on requests.
The system shall allow the supplier to edit their profile.
The system shall allow the coordinator to manage resource locations.
